## Download

Download **`Rastro-windows-x64.exe`** below and run it. There's nothing to install. Windows will probably warn you the first time because the file isn't signed yet: click **More info → Run anyway**. The [README](https://github.com/MaxSala/rastro-tarkov#is-it-safe) explains why, and how to check the file yourself.

Already using Rastro? Close it and replace the old `.exe` with this one. Your settings, points, maps and prices are kept.

## What's new

**See which floor you're on**
- Maps with several floors (Customs dorms, Interchange, Reserve, Shoreline resort, Streets, Factory…) now have a floor panel at the top left of the map, stacked like the building.
- The floor you're looking at stays sharp while the rest of the map is dimmed. Extracts, containers, locks, your points and your teammates on other floors fade out too, so it's clear what's on your level.
- *Automatic* still follows your height and position, and shows which floor it picked.

**Better hover cards**
- Hover anything on the map to see what it is, its name, how far it is, which floor it's on and what clicking does.
- Markers react when you hover them, and labels that were hidden to avoid clutter appear.

**Clear about what Rastro reads**
- The setup guide, *Settings → About* and the README now say plainly that Rastro reads two things the game writes to disk: the file names of your screenshots (your position) and, only if you turn on raid detection, the game's log files (current map, raid start and timer).

**Fixes**
- Turning raid detection on or off no longer resets a custom logs folder.
- A few internal messages were still in Spanish.

**For people sharing the download link:** the file is now always called `Rastro-windows-x64.exe`, so [this link](https://github.com/MaxSala/rastro-tarkov/releases/latest/download/Rastro-windows-x64.exe) always downloads the newest version.

Full history in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/MaxSala/rastro-tarkov/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
